title: 第10章 oi！祖宝：哼。。。
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

莱恩已经腾空而去。

贝卡浑身的力气都被彻底抽空，心如刀绞，整个人软软地瘫倒在丈夫比利的怀里。

比利紧紧抱住爱人，胸腔里回荡着怒火与隐秘的窃喜。

在这一天，贝卡她失去了她的儿子，比利他找回了他的妻子，而桥头更远一些的一颗大树后，祖国人却再也克制不住狂喜，肆无忌惮地放声大笑。

那笑声穿透树林、穿透桥梁，尖锐、癫狂、又带着极致的得意和无尽的喜悦。

是的，在场没有听懂莱恩最后话语的人，正是阿祖。

早在莱恩挂断电话说要出去飞一圈时，阿祖就通过监控察觉到了不对劲，他因此赶来。

赶来以后，他正好从头至尾观赏了这样一场大戏。

“啪，啪，啪！”

“祖国人！”

比利再次要将妻子护在身后，但这一次贝卡却勇敢地站了出来，直面祖国人。

“祖国人，你，绝不能，伤害莱恩！”

贝卡的声音颤抖，却又带着孤注一掷的决绝：“还有，我会将他夺回来的！”

“一定！”

“嗯嗯，嗯嗯…”

阿祖听得连连点头，一副耐心倾听且非常认可的样子。

等贝卡说完，他才缓缓道：“你说，假如我现在杀掉你们，我的儿子会知道吗？”

“嘭——”

空气再次炸响。

只是这一次却不再是莱恩的轻描淡写，而是瞬息之间咫尺天涯一般的空中极速挪移。

阿祖的速度根本就不是比利、贝卡所能防备的，他们的瞳孔刚开始收缩，脖颈就在下一秒被一股恐怖的力道死死锁住。

这一对原配的公母俩人也不是任人宰割的小角色。

即使是贝卡，也在变故发生后的短暂懵神后立即做出应对。

手腕一翻，贝卡藏在裤兜里的匕首瞬间出鞘，毫不犹豫，想都不想地就朝祖国人的眼睛扎去。

同时，比利也抬枪顶住祖国人的额头，扳机连扣，砰砰砰的枪声瞬时大作。

阿祖闭左眼，匕首折断。

阿祖开右眼，融化枪口。

“嘭——”

爆鸣似的飞行又一次响彻，只是这一次的飞行速度却慢了许多。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Ryan had already taken off.

All the strength in Beka's body was completely drained, her heart was in a knife's edge, and she collapsed softly in the arms of her husband Billy.

Billy hugged his lover tightly, his chest reverberating with anger and secret joy.

On this day, Beka lost her son and Billy found his wife. However, behind a big tree farther away from the bridge, the people of the motherland could no longer restrain their ecstasy and laughed unbridled.

The laughter penetrated the woods and bridges, sharp, crazy, and filled with ultimate pride and endless joy.

Yes, the person present who did not understand Ryan's last words was Azu.

As early as when Ryan hung up the phone and said he wanted to go out for a flight, Azu noticed something was wrong through the surveillance camera, so he came over.

After arriving, he happened to watch such a great show from beginning to end.

"Pah, pah, pah!"

"People of the motherland!"

Billy once again wanted to protect his wife behind him, but this time Beca bravely stood up and faced the people of the motherland.

"Fellow people of the motherland, you must never harm Ryan!"

Beka's voice was trembling, but also filled with desperate determination: "And I will take him back!"

"Definitely!"

"Uh-huh, uh-huh..."

Azu nodded repeatedly, looking patiently listening and approving.

After Beka finished speaking, he slowly said: "Tell me, if I kill you now, will my son know?"

"Bang——"

The air exploded again.

Only this time, it was no longer Ryan's understatement, but a rapid movement in the air that was as close as the end of the world in an instant.

Azu's speed was beyond what Billy and Beka could guard against. As soon as their pupils began to shrink, their necks were locked tightly with a terrifying force in the next second.

The father and mother of this original pair are not small characters who can be manipulated by others.

Even Becca responded immediately after being briefly confused after the accident.

With a flick of her wrist, Beka's dagger hidden in her trouser pocket was instantly unsheathed, and she stabbed the motherland man in the eye without hesitation or thought.

At the same time, Billy also raised his gun to the forehead of the motherland, pulled the trigger repeatedly, and the gunshots were loud and loud.

Azu closed his left eye and broke the dagger.

Azu opened his right eye and melted the muzzle of the gun.

"Bang——"

The explosive flying sound sounded again, but this time the flying speed was much slower.
